questions.prompt:
(Exam 2026 — reading, question 1a)
The text is about World Caring Day: the health club of a school visits the children's hospital. It says: "Everyone was excited. Most students bought toys and storybooks for sick kids." True or false: "All the students bought presents for the children." Which answer is right, with its reason?

options.text: False: "most students bought" presents means some of them did not.
True: "everyone was excited", so every student bought a present.
True: "most students bought" presents means the same as "all of them".
False: "everyone was excited" means that nobody bought a present.

questions.explanation: The text says that most students bought toys and storybooks, and most is not all: some students did not buy a present, so the statement is false. Being excited does not prove that every student bought something, and it does not prove that nobody did either, and most never means the same as all.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2026 — reading, question 1b)
The text says: "On the big day, the club mates did a clown show that made everyone laugh." Did the sick kids enjoy the clown show? Pick the answer that gives the right reason.

options.text: No: the clown show was only for the students and not for the children.
No: nobody laughs in a hospital, so the children did not enjoy it.
Yes: the show "made everyone laugh", so the sick children laughed too.
Yes: the show was the present that Adam made for a little girl.

questions.explanation: The show made everyone laugh, and the sick children were part of everyone, so they enjoyed it: the answer is yes. The text never says that the show was only for the students, what happens in a hospital is not a proof of what happened on that day, and the present that Adam made was a bracelet, not the show.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2026 — reading, question 2)
Complete the paragraph with words taken from the text: "On World Caring Day, the health club members visited the children's hospital. Adam and his friends ___ to present fun activities and offer gifts to the kids. They wanted to ___ their care for them." Which pair of words completes it?

options.text: organize ... express
decided ... express
decided ... laugh
organize ... laugh

questions.explanation: The first blank needs a past verb followed by to, the verb of the choice that the group made in the text: decided. The second blank follows wanted to, so the verb is bare and it says how the children are shown the care: express, as in the sentence about the colourful bracelets. Organize cannot follow friends in a past sentence, and laugh does not go with care.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2026 — reading, question 3)
The text says: "On the big day, the club mates did a clown show that made everyone laugh. Then, they offered their gifts to the sick children." The underlined word is they. What does they refer to?

options.text: everyone
the sick children
the clown
the club mates

questions.explanation: Put each answer back in the sentence: the ones who offered the gifts to the sick children are the club mates, who did the show and then gave their presents. Everyone is the nearest word before they, but everyone is the audience that laughs while they are the ones who give the presents, and the sick children are the ones who receive the gifts.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2026 — reading, question 4)
The text says: "When Adam gave a bracelet to a little girl, she looked thrilled and said, 'thank you for this wonderful day.'" Which word of the text means very happy?

options.text: thrilled
wonderful
beautiful
special

questions.explanation: The sentence says how the little girl looked and then that she said thank you, so the word that means very happy and describes her is thrilled. Wonderful describes the day, beautiful describes the bracelets and special describes the present, and none of the three names a feeling.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2026 — reading, question 5)
The text begins: "There is a special day about caring that you may not know! Every year, on 7th June, World Caring Day is celebrated." When do people celebrate World Caring Day?

options.text: Every month, on the 7th.
Once a year, on 7th June.
Every day, because it is a special day.
On 7th July, in the summer holidays.

questions.explanation: The text says every year, on 7th June, so the day comes once a year and always in June. Seeing the number 7 and stopping there gives every month on the 7th, a special day is not a day that comes every day, and July is another month that the text never names.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2026 — reading, question 6)
A text tells how a school health club visits a children's hospital on World Caring Day: the students bring toys and storybooks, a boy gives a hand-made bracelet, a clown show makes everyone laugh and a little girl says thank you. Which title fits the whole text best?

options.text: The story of a boy and his colourful bracelets
Why a clown show makes everyone laugh
Small acts of care make a difference
Toys and storybooks for every child

questions.explanation: Every part of the visit shows that a small gesture of care can matter to others, and a good title names the idea that covers the whole text. The bracelets, the clown show and the toys are three details of the visit, and each of them tells only a piece of the text.
